name: research-desk
description: Research Desk CLI: launch, watch, steer and review supervised research. Commands dispatch at the top level; each group is one API domain.

groups.name: activity
groups.description: What is moving: commissions, topics, sessions and read sets, derived from the research home

commands.name: now
commands.description: State counts (live, paused and limited apart), open supervisor windows, overlaps and unavailable lenses

commands.name: commissions
commands.description: Every commission with its derived state, newest last write first

flags.name: state
flags.description: Only commissions in this state; repeatable

commands.name: commission
commands.description: One commission with every derived field's source, its sessions and read sets

commands.name: topics
commands.description: Every topic with its last activity, commissions and mission check

commands.name: changes
commands.description: What changed in a commission or topic since the last recorded look, or since a time

positionals.name: subject
positionals.bind_waiver: The CLI maps the word to the ChangeSubject enum.

positionals.name: id
positionals.description: Commission folder name or topic slug

flags.name: since
flags.description: Compare with this UTC time (RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-11-11T19:00:00Z) instead of the recorded look; lists files and checkpoints only

groups.name: launch
groups.description: Packets through packet.py, launch through Web Console or by hand, and controls typed only on the operator's command; writes a commission folder only by packet.py build and LAUNCH.json

commands.name: launch-options
commands.description: Supervisor model, effort and owner tier defaults and choices from limits.json, the packet gates, whether an automatic launch can reach Web Console, and for the topics given the suggested stance quotes with their source and each workstream's title and showcase line

flags.name: topics
flags.description: Comma-separated topic slugs: suggest stance quotes and list their workstreams

commands.name: preflight
commands.description: Gate a spec (packet.py preview) or a commission (packet.py check) and say what every earlier commission on its topics means for a launch: the blockers, their choices and the desk's recommendation

positionals.name: target
positionals.description: A prepared commission folder name, or (from the command line) a spec JSON file; give a spec with --spec-file otherwise
positionals.bind_waiver: From the command line a path to an existing file is read and sent as spec_json instead.

flags.name: spec-file
flags.description: A spec JSON file (FILE-CONTRACT §2) to gate instead of a commission

flags.name: supersede
flags.description: Comma-separated blocking commissions this launch supersedes: each is stopped through its own session first and recorded as superseded

flags.name: alongside
flags.description: Comma-separated blocking commissions this launch runs alongside

flags.name: assert-never-started
flags.description: The operator's word that this unknown commission was never started; refused when the desk finds any session or goal for it

commands.name: build
commands.description: Write a new commission folder with packet.py build, from a spec JSON file or, with --relaunch-of, from an earlier commission's PACKET.json (superseding it and carrying its baseline)

positionals.name: spec-file
positionals.description: A spec JSON file (FILE-CONTRACT §2); omit with --relaunch-of

flags.name: relaunch-of
flags.description: Relaunch this earlier commission as a new one

flags.name: supersede
flags.description: Comma-separated blocking commissions this packet supersedes: its charter names each, and the launch stops their supervisors first

flags.name: alongside
flags.description: Comma-separated blocking commissions this packet runs alongside: its charter names each

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Launch a prepared commission (or an unknown one the operator asserts never started) through Web Console in the background, resolving each blocker; follow with launch-status

flags.name: supersede
flags.description: Comma-separated blocking commissions this launch supersedes: each is stopped through its own session first and recorded as superseded

flags.name: alongside
flags.description: Comma-separated blocking commissions this launch runs alongside

flags.name: assert-never-started
flags.description: The operator's word that this unknown commission was never started; refused when the desk finds any session or goal for it

commands.name: launch-messages
commands.description: Print a built packet's charter path, stance and kernel to paste by hand; writes nothing

commands.name: launch-status
commands.description: A commission's LAUNCH.json: steps, failure, controls and discard, and whether an attempt is running

commands.name: control
commands.description: Pause, resume, stop or discard a commission, or paste its stance again; the goal status is read back and the control recorded in LAUNCH.json

positionals.name: action
positionals.description: pause, resume, stop, discard or resend-stance
positionals.bind_waiver: The CLI maps the word to the ControlAction enum.

flags.name: reason
flags.description: The operator's words; required for discard

commands.name: launch-test
commands.description: Start one throwaway, labelled session with a harmless stance and a kernel that completes at once, then pause, resume and stop it; follow with launch-test-status

commands.name: launch-test-status
commands.description: The newest launch test: each step, the goal status after the goal, pause and resume, and whether the session was stopped

groups.name: operator
groups.description: The operator's words, answers, verdicts and the courier to Notification Hub; writes only OPERATOR.md, VERDICTS.md, a charter's Steering section and the courier switches

commands.name: needs-you
commands.description: Everything that needs the operator, with answers, whether a unit has run since, and what the courier would send (dry run)

commands.name: answer
commands.description: Answer a needs-you item into the commission's OPERATOR.md

positionals.name: option-key
positionals.description: One of the item's option keys, or other with --note

flags.name: note
flags.description: The operator's words: a note on the option, or the whole answer for other

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Print the exact text that would be appended; writes nothing

commands.name: say
commands.description: Give direction or wind down, in the operator's words, through OPERATOR.md

positionals.name: kind
positionals.bind_waiver: The CLI maps the word to the EntryKind enum.

positionals.name: text
positionals.description: The operator's words, quoted; a wind-down without words uses the standard sentence

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Print the exact text that would be appended; writes nothing

commands.name: enable-steering
commands.description: Append the Steering section to an older charter so its scheduler reads OPERATOR.md

commands.name: reviews
commands.description: Reviews with their REVIEW.md, REVIEW.html, proposals and verdicts

commands.name: verdict
commands.description: Record the operator's verdict on one topic of a review, verbatim

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Print the exact text that would be appended; writes nothing

commands.name: courier
commands.description: Turn the courier to Notification Hub on or off for a commission, or for global ATTENTION.md items

positionals.name: switch
positionals.bind_waiver: The CLI maps the word to the on field.

flags.name: global
flags.description: Switch global ATTENTION.md items instead of a commission

commands.name: courier-test
commands.description: Raise one delivery-test ask through Vrooli Events and wait for delivery; it expires unanswered after 15 minutes

commands.name: mark-seen
commands.description: Record the operator's look at a commission or topic, or with --all at every one (caught up), so `changes` reports from now

positionals.name: subject
positionals.bind_waiver: The CLI maps the word to the ChangeSubject enum.

positionals.name: id
positionals.description: Commission folder name or topic slug; omit with --all

flags.name: all
flags.description: Record a look at every commission and topic at once
